title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Anthropic API
providers.scope_notes: Covers Anthropic Claude API (Claude Console / Claude Platform). Claude Console organizations on platform.claude.com; Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) compliance keys and App Attest device tokens are noted but not catalogued as paths.

controls.name: Maximum expiration policy
controls.what: Console limits key expiration to the policy maximum and removes Never.

controls.name: Disable / Re-enable API key
controls.what: Reversibly sets the key to inactive.
controls.setting: Console Settings > API keys, or POST /v1/organizations/api_keys/{api_key_id} status=inactive

controls.name: Delete API key (archive)
controls.setting: Console Settings > API keys, or Update API Key status=archived

controls.name: Workspace-scoped keys
controls.what: A key created for one workspace only works there and cannot reach the Admin API.

controls.name: Archive workspace
controls.what: Archives every key created for the workspace within seconds.
controls.setting: Console Settings > Workspaces or Admin API

controls.name: Remove user / archive service account
controls.what: Personal keys stop on user removal; service account keys stop on account archive.

controls.name: Member API key creation setting
controls.what: Org setting that allows members to create new API keys (changes logged as api_key_creation_enabled).
controls.setting: Org setting; UI path not stated

controls.name: Compliance API (Activity Feed)
controls.what: Must be on for key and federation activity to be recorded.
controls.setting: Claude Console > Settings > Security > Compliance API
controls.plan: Eligible organizations (self-service) or via account team

controls_unknown: Customer IP allowlisting for Claude API requests (not found in docs).
Whether keys or OAuth tokens are subject to SSO / IdP conditional access.

Lifetime and admin revocation of ant CLI OAuth tokens.
Console UI path for the maximum expiration policy and the member API key creation setting.

authentication.summary: Static sk-ant-api... secret linked to a user; every request acts as that user with their roles. Scoped to one workspace or all workspaces the user can use.

federation.details: Fetched docs do not say whether API keys are subject to SSO or IdP conditional access.

ip_restriction.boundary: No customer IP allowlist for Claude API requests found in fetched docs; the IP addresses page only lists Anthropic's own ranges.

lifetime.summary: Chosen at creation (3h/1d/7d/30d/custom/Never); org max expiration policy can remove Never

renewal.summary: Expired keys cannot be reactivated; create a new key.

administration.summary: Created in Console by users with key-creation rights (e.g. Workspace Developer). Admins can list, rename, deactivate or archive via Admin API, but not create. Stops working when the user is removed.
administration.conditions: An org-wide (unscoped) personal key also works on the Admin API with the user's permissions.

offboard.details: Personal keys are archived and stop working when the user is removed from the organization.

inventory.details: Admins can list all keys with GET /v1/organizations/api_keys (List API Keys); each entry shows the principal, so personal keys are identifiable.

expiry.ui: Console > API keys (platform.claude.com/settings/keys): expiration chosen at Create key; table shows each key's expiration

reads.api: GET /v1/compliance/activities?activity_types[]=platform_file_content_downloaded; match actor.api_key_id client-side (actor_ids[] accepts only user_ IDs)

offboard.api: DELETE /v1/organizations/users/{user_id} (400 if SCIM manages membership; remove in IdP instead)

token_format.notes: Docs show sk-ant-api03- for Claude API keys

log_sources.name: Compliance API Activity Feed (GET /v1/compliance/activities)
log_sources.notes: Must be enabled; 6-year retention; not retroactive. Admin API keys can read it.

log_sources.name: Usage and Cost API
log_sources.notes: Aggregated usage filterable by API key.

containment.steps: Disable (reversible) or delete (archive) the key; or remove the user from the org.
containment.notes: Docs say the key stops working but give no timing.

evidence.title: Manage WIF with the Admin API
